description: Look up UK postcodes and geocode from a workflow, with no account and no API key. Get everything the Office for National Statistics holds for a postcode - coordinates, country, region, local authority district, ward, parish, parliamentary constituency, NHS and statistical areas, and the GSS code for each. Validate a postcode against the real directory rather than a regular expression, and find out when a retired one was withdrawn. Turn coordinates into postcodes and postcodes into coordinates, search or autocomplete a partial postcode, and list what is nearby. Look up hundreds of postcodes or coordinate pairs in one step. Measure the distance between two postcodes. Read an outward code as a whole postal area, search Ordnance Survey's gazetteer of British places, and get the Scottish-only geographies - council area, Data Zone, SIMD - that the UK-wide directory does not carry. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything.
